Enumerated by what TOUCHES the decode's state rather than by what any file names, that body is one of EIGHT touchers and the other seven have a stack: 1 setup (page_in.emp, ZX0 arm of PageIn_Process -- picks a0/a1/a3 and PageIn_Cur_Bytes); 2 completion (page_in.emp .after -- receives a0/a1, ZX0R's declared out); 3 slice-out (PageIn_BankRegs -- banks d0-d2/a0-a3 + SR mid-decode); 4 slice-in (PageIn_Resume -- re-materialises the same set); 5 bookmark (vblank.emp PC range check -- touches the PC and PageIn_InFlight, not the stream); 6 landing (PageIn_EnqueueLanding -- consumes the declared extent as a DMA length); 7 selftest (compression_selftest.emp .eq_page/.eq_resume -- drives BOTH decoders over every act-pool page); 8 bake (tools/ojz_strip_gen.py -- makes the wrapper and pm_tiles). DERIVED NUMBERS (sigil's cycle table, sigil crates/sigil-isa/src/m68k_cycles.rs = MC68000UM tables 8-1/8-6 as a generating rule, which CODING_CONVENTIONS names as the authority): moveq exact 4, swap exact 4, move.w (a0),d0 = 4 + ea_time(Ind,word) 4 + ea_time(Dn) 0 = 8, tst.w (a0) = 4 + ea_time(Ind,word) 4 = 8, movea.l d0,a1 = 4 + 0 + 0 = 4. detail: FIXED 2026-09-12 (merge 1f7c44f6): Collision_GetType computes floor((L+O)/2) with one add.w Cache_Origin_Row before the shift, instead of halving the origin separately (floor(L/2)+O/2): -12 cycles per cache-hit lookup (derived, 36 -> 24), 4 bytes smaller, no RAM and no representation change. NOT the row's 'store the halved origin': that form cost the seven full-value readers ~+20 B to save 4. Equal iff the cache origin is even; exhaustively checked on the ROMs' own bytes (29,640 even cases, 0 disagreements; odd-origin control 14,400) and the premise re-checked by the controller at every writer (both TileCache_VSlide(Up) callers pass moveq #2, the wrap is +/-TILE_CACHE_ROWS = 60, the others store 0). Unguarded at build time: ensure(TILE_CACHE_ROWS % 2 == 0) is booked, not added. All four ROMs change content and none changes size (a -4 B shift absorbed by the $10000 placement; nothing listed above $10000 moved; every tail byte that differs is a -4 address or displacement into the shifted range, 60 in s4 and 82 in s4.debug; demo tails byte-identical). Control at a warp-re-seeded origin 0: rest y 573, 12/12. Limit: floor(L/2)+O/2 equals floor((L+O)/2) at every even origin, so no run can tell the shipped form from the old one; this shows the shipped lookup reads the committed cell at a non-zero origin. Layer 0 and one standing column only.
